Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or

 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  14.05.2024 AO No.118 of 2024  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The proposed Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the owner of the offending vehicle challenging the Award dated 19.12.2023, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/Vth Additional District Judge, Haridwar, in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.188 of 2021, by which, the learned Tribunal has awarded a total sum of Rs.18,26,000/-/- (Rupees eighteen lakh twenty six thousand) as compensation along with an interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till its actual payment.
2.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/Vth Additional District Judge, Haridwar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Motor Accident Claim Petition No.188 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Heard Mrs. Indu Sharma, learned counsel for appellant.
Issue notice to the respondent nos.1 to 4 and respondent no.9.

5. Steps to be taken within a week.
6.

7. Heard on the Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2024).
8.
Mrs. Indu Sharma, Advocate, has sought four weeks' time from today to deposit Rs.11,00,000/-(Rupees eleven lakh) before the Tribunal concerned.

9. Subject to depositing of Rs.11,00,000/-(Rupees eleven lakh), as prayed, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 19.12.2023 are stayed till further order.
10.
Stay Application No.01 of 2024 stands disposed of accordingly.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 14.05.2024 Neha AO/118/2024 on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103250439/
